description: Check Sphere's Ed25519 signature on any contract: returns contract_hash, signature, public_key and signature_valid. Free, no key. The same check as GET https://starsphera.com/marketplace/contracts/{contract_id}/verify-signature; the public key is also at https://starsphera.com/.well-known/sphere-identity.json.

contract_id.description: The contract id returned when the contract was created (marketplace_create_contract).

name: marketplace_verify_signature
title: Verify a contract signature
